item.title: ₹7.5 lakh crore private investment likely in nuke sector; 30 GW contribution by 2047: AEC chief Mohanty
item.description: The country currently has about 9 GW of installed nuclear power capacity and plans to expand it substantially by 2047, Atomic Energy Commission Chairman Ajit Kumar Mohanty said.

item.title: India initiates anti-dumping probe on Pen-G, salts from China
item.description: The DGTR, which agreed to the company’s suggestion for 2025-26 as the period of investigation, said there is sufficient prima facie evidence that the PUC is being dumped into the domestic market by exporters from China.

item.title: SEBI to issue guidelines on CAS in a week: Chairman Pandey
item.description: SEBI had sought public comments till October 3 on proposals to review certain aspects of the CAS mechanism, market timings and the settlement methodology for derivative contracts

item.title: India-U.S. trade pact to be finalised keeping changed circumstances in mind: Piyush Goyal
item.description: Piyush Goyal also said trade pact negotiations are on with number of regions including Israel, Chile, GCC, and Russia-led group Eurasian Economic Union

item.title: DPA positions Kandla as green fuels, shipping hub
item.description: DPA said it was actively advancing India’s commitment towards achieving Net Zero by 2070
